newsitem.title: USA: 3Com, DSC pact to cut carrier cost.
newsitem.headline: 3Com, DSC pact to cut carrier cost.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp and 3Com Corp said Tuesday they had a pact to present Internet solutions that would cut carriers' network costs and also cut network congestion triggered by heavy Internet data traffic.

The pact calls for interoperability between 3Com's Total Control remote access server and DSC's Intelligent Internet Solutions. It would enable carriers to redirect Internet calls off the telephone network and on to higher-speed data networks for Internet traffic, the companies said.
Carriers would then be able to develop systems to end data traffic at lower costs by using standard inter-machine trunks, rather than more expensive trunks, the companies said.
"This new capability will enable carriers to reduce their network costs while rapidly expanding the types of services they can deliver," DSC said in a joint release with 3Com.
